title: Table owners (proposal, story L-07)
description: Shape of contracts/db/table-owners.yaml, proposed by Tanmay for Akshay to confirm (handoff in docs/dev/HANDOFFS.md, tasks P-05 and P-06). One entry per database table, naming the one module that owns it. Owner values must be module folders of apps/api/src/vulnmart/ listed in .github/CODEOWNERS; that cross-check and the duplicate-table check are made by scripts/check_table_owners.py.
